name: tail
summary: Shows the end of a file, optionally as it grows.
description: Shows the last lines (10 by default) of each file. With -f, it stays open and shows new lines as they arrive: the classic tool for following a log.

options.description: Number of lines to show. With a plus sign (-n +5), shows from line 5 onwards.
Number of bytes to show instead of lines.
Follows the file: shows added lines in real time. Ctrl+C to stop.
Like -f, but keeps going if the file is renamed or recreated (log rotation).
Does not print file name headers.
With -f, interval in seconds between two checks.
With -f, stops when the given process ends.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: File(s) to read. Without a file: standard input.

examples.explanation: The last 10 lines of the system log.
Follows the requests nginx receives, live.
The whole file except the header line.
